title: Part
spec:
Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin with the first loop, which consists of twelve lines forming a cross-shaped outline. The first line starts from the origin at (0.0, 0.4977) and extends horizontally to (0.317, 0.4977). The second line moves vertically down to (0.317, 0.0), followed by a horizontal line to (0.3648, 0.0). The fourth line goes back up to (0.3648, 0.4977), then continues horizontally to (0.6818, 0.4977). The sixth line moves vertically up to (0.6818, 0.5455), followed by a horizontal line back to (0.3648, 0.5455). The eighth line extends vertically to (0.3648, 0.75), then moves horizontally to (0.317, 0.75). The tenth line goes down to (0.317, 0.5455), followed by a horizontal line to (0.0, 0.5455), and finally, the twelfth line completes the loop by returning to the starting point at (0.0, 0.4977).

In the second loop, draw a single circle centered at (0.0136, 0.5216) with a radius of 0.0051. In the third loop, draw another circle centered at (0.3409, 0.0273) with the same radius. The fourth loop involves drawing a circle centered at (0.3409, 0.5216) with a radius of 0.0051. Finally, in the fifth loop, draw a circle centered at (0.6682, 0.5216) with the same radius.

After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0341 units in the positive normal direction and 0.0 units in the negative normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.6818181818181815 units, a width of 0.7499999999999998 units, and a height of 0.03409090909090909 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the cross-shaped sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.4977) \
     .lineTo(0.317, 0.4977) \
     .lineTo(0.317, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.3648, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.3648, 0.4977) \
     .lineTo(0.6818, 0.4977) \
     .lineTo(0.6818, 0.5455) \
     .lineTo(0.3648, 0.5455) \
     .lineTo(0.3648, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.317, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.317, 0.5455) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.5455) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.4977) \
     .close()

# Create the circular holes
r = r.moveTo(0.0136, 0.5216) \
     .circle(0.0051) \
     .moveTo(0.3409, 0.0273) \
     .circle(0.0051) \
     .moveTo(0.3409, 0.5216) \
     .circle(0.0051) \
     .moveTo(0.6682, 0.5216) \
     .circle(0.0051)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0341)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Overall bounding box: X 0.6818, Y 0.7500, Z 0.0341
# Cross-shaped flat bracket made of two crossing bars.

bar_width = 0.05       # width of each bar
thk = 0.0341           # thickness (Z)
len_x = 0.6818         # horizontal bar length
len_y = 0.75           # vertical bar length

# Horizontal bar (along X), centered at origin
h_bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(len_x, bar_width, thk)

# Vertical bar (along Y), centered at origin
v_bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(bar_width, len_y, thk)

# Union the two bars
body = h_bar.union(v_bar)

# Hole diameter
hole_d = 0.015

# Holes through both bars:
# - near left and right ends of horizontal bar
# - near bottom end of vertical bar
# - one at the center intersection
holes = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .pushPoints([(-0.30, 0.0), (0.30, 0.0)])
    .circle(hole_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(thk, combine=False)
)

holes_v = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .pushPoints([(0.0, -len_y / 2.0 + 0.03), (0.0, 0.0)])
    .circle(hole_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(thk, combine=False)
)

# Cut holes through the part
r = body.cut(holes).cut(holes_v)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

X = 0.6818
Y = 0.7500
Z = 0.0341
W = 0.0500
HOLE_D = 0.0100
END_INSET = 0.0300

# The horizontal bar is offset toward the short upper leg of the cross.
y_cross = 0.125

horizontal = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(X, W, Z, centered=(True, True, False))
    .translate((0, y_cross, 0))
)

vertical = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(W, Y, Z, centered=(True, True, False))
)

r = horizontal.union(vertical)

hole_points = [
    (0, y_cross),                         # center
    (-(X / 2 - END_INSET), y_cross),      # left end
    (X / 2 - END_INSET, y_cross),         # right end
    (0, -(Y / 2 - END_INSET)),            # long lower end
]

for x, y in hole_points:
    cutter = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .center(x, y)
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2)
        .extrude(Z + 0.002)
        .translate((0, 0, -0.001))
    )
    r = r.cut(cutter)
